name: Eating Pigs
overview: God clearly commands His people to observe dietary laws that distinguish clean and unclean animals, as seen in Leviticus 11 where the swine is declared unclean because it does not chew the cud despite having cloven hooves. This prohibition is reaffirmed in Isaiah 66, warning that those who eat swine's flesh defile themselves and face judgment. These instructions emphasize holiness and separation from practices associated with impurity, underscoring the call for God's people to honor Him through obedience to His commands.
